keyEvents.text: First Half begins.

Goal! Jagiellonia Bialystok 1, Backa Topola 0. Kristoffer Normann Hansen (Jagiellonia Bialystok) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jesús Imaz with a through ball following a fast break.
Goal! Jagiellonia Bialystok 1, Backa Topola 1. Marko Lazetic (Backa Topola) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Ivan Milosavljevic with a cross.
Mateusz Skrzypczak (Jagiellonia Bialystok) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Milan Radin (Backa Topola) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Jagiellonia Bialystok. Norbert Wojtuszek replaces Michal Sácek because of an injury.
Petar Stanic (Backa Topola) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Enzo Ebosse (Jagiellonia Bialystok) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Jagiellonia Bialystok 1, Backa Topola 1.
Substitution, Backa Topola. Dragoljub Savic replaces Ivan Milosavljevic.
Goal! Jagiellonia Bialystok 2, Backa Topola 1. Jesús Imaz (Jagiellonia Bialystok) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Miki Villar.
Substitution, Jagiellonia Bialystok. Darko Churlinov replaces Miki Villar.
Substitution, Jagiellonia Bialystok. Oskar Pietuszewski replaces Kristoffer Normann Hansen.
Aleksa Pejic (Backa Topola) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Own Goal by Viktor Radojevic, Backa Topola. Jagiellonia Bialystok 3, Backa Topola 1.
Substitution, Backa Topola. Milos Pantovic replaces Aleksa Pejic.
Substitution, Backa Topola. Bence Sós replaces Prestige Mboungou.
